scripts.build: next build && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); function copyRecursive(src, dst) { if (!fs.existsSync(src)) return; if (!fs.existsSync(dst)) fs.mkdirSync(dst, { recursive: true }); const items = fs.readdirSync(src); items.forEach(item => { const srcPath = path.join(src, item); const dstPath = path.join(dst, item); if (fs.statSync(srcPath).isDirectory()) { copyRecursive(srcPath, dstPath); } else { fs.copyFileSync(srcPath, dstPath); } }); } copyRecursive('.next/static', '.next/standalone/.next/'); copyRecursive('public', '.next/standalone/public');"
